headline: HSIE Results Daily: Go Digit General Insurance, Data Patterns

highlights: HSIE Research is also available on Bloomberg ERH HDF <GO> & Thomson Reuters 11 November 2026 HSIE Results Daily HSIE Results Daily Contents Results Reviews ■ Go Digit General Insurance: Go Digit reported a weak set of numbers under the new Ind‑AS regime, delivering 1.7% YoY insurance‑revenue growth alongside a 31.4% YoY decline in PAT.
The PAT miss reflected elevated loss ratios, led by Gujarat flood losses (~INR630mn) and softer momentum across key business lines as the company consciously prioritized profitability over growth.

Given the management commentary on softness in motor and commercial lines of business, we build in 6/9% CAGR of insurance revenue/PAT over FY27-29E, with CISR assumptions of 100/101% over FY27/28E as we expect Go Digit to adapt its operating model to the IRDAI’s proposals around distribution commission.

Relative valuations appear elevated, driven largely by Go Digit’s thin profitability and the shift to new accounting standards (none of the other comparable multi-line players have yet migrated). ■ Data Patterns: Data Patterns Ltd (DPL) recorded a weak Q2FY27 execution, reflected in 57% YoY revenue degrowth, due to a high base created by an exceptionally strong execution in Q2FY26.
valuation: We maintain ADD with a revised target price of INR300 (43x Sep-28E EPS).

Relative valuations appear elevated, driven largely by Go Digit’s thin profitability and the shift to new accounting standards (none of the other comparable multi-line players have yet migrated). ■ Data Patterns: Data Patterns Ltd (DPL) recorded a weak Q2FY27 execution, reflected in 57% YoY revenue degrowth, due to a high base created by an exceptionally strong execution in Q2FY26.
Following this, we maintain ADD rating with a lower multiple 45x (reduced from 55x) as we roll forward to FY29E.
watch: The PAT miss reflected elevated loss ratios, led by Gujarat flood losses (~INR630mn) and softer momentum across key business lines as the company consciously prioritized profitability over growth.
Large platform system orders such as the INR 10bn from HAL, QRSAM, Brahmos seekers orders and progress in counter drone’s domain will remain the key monitorable.
